title: 2009 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Ox
seo_title: 2009 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Ox (26 January – 13 February 2010)
description: 2009 is the Year of the Earth Ox (Yin, Ji-chou), from 26 January 2009 to 13 February 2010. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2009.
lead: Born in 2009? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Ox, but check the date: the 2009 Earth Ox year began on 26 January 2009. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2009: Year of the Earth Ox, from 26 January 2009 to 13 February 2010.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2009 was the Year of the Ox. It began with Lunar New Year on 26 January 2009 and ended on 13 February 2010, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2009 ends in 9, which makes it an Earth year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2009 is a Ji-chou year. The same Earth Ox combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1949 before it and 2069 after it.
Lunar New Year 2009 fell on 26 January 2009. Anyone born from 1 January 2009 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rat; from 26 January 2009 on, the Ox.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Ox guide describes the sign like this: “Reliable, honest, and hard-working. Oxen build success slowly and steadily through persistence.” The usual watch-out: “Can be stubborn and slow to adapt to sudden change.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Ox page.
Careers often linked with the Ox: agriculture, engineering, finance, medicine.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2009
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Ox's best matches are the Rat, Snake and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Goat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Ox, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Ox, it sits directly opposite the Goat, so 2027 is its clash year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Ox years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1985 (Wood Ox); 1997 (Fire Ox); 2021 (Metal Ox); 2033 (Water Ox). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2009 is the Year of the Ox, a Yin Earth Ox year (Ji-chou).
When does the 2009 Year of the Ox start and end?
It starts on 26 January 2009 and ends on 13 February 2010.
I was born in January 2009. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 26 January 2009, you are a Rat; from 26 January 2009 on, a Ox.
Earth. 2009 ends in 9, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Ox compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Snake and Rooster. The Ox's clash sign is the Goat.
